intro.narration: Afternoon at Lolo Carding's house. The coffee is hot, and the hands at the table are hotter.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Oh, my grandchild finally shows up. You really think you can beat me?

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Lolo, don't scare them too much! ...but yeah, you've been losing here for a while, huh. Just saying.

intro.speaker: generic_1
intro.text: I'm just the neighbor, sitting in for a game. Don't drag me into the family drama.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Sit down. You're the one holding the three of clubs.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: So you go first. It's tradition, kid.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Wow, so much drama, like a soap opera. Come on, put your cards down already.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Quiet. Good. A great player speaks through the cards, not the mouth.

intro.narration: Lolo slowly set the house keys down beside the table.

intro.speaker: lolo_carding
intro.text: Win tonight? These are yours. Lose? You're washing dishes all week.

win.narration: Last card. Nothing left in your hand.

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: Huh?! You're out?! Wait, wait, let's count that again...

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: THEY'RE REALLY OUT! Lolo lost! This is a historic day! I'm telling the whole neighborhood!

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: ...but, good. You learned. Next time, try that skill out on the street.

win.speaker: lolo_carding
win.text: Go on, take the keys home. It's your house too, anyway.

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Told you so. A little more practice, kid.

lose.speaker: ate_marites
lose.text: Aw, next time then. Grab that towel, we've got a lot of dishes later. Hehe.

lose.speaker: lolo_carding
lose.text: Don't be sad. Sit back down. One more game?

lines.speaker: lolo_carding
lines.text: Wait... you only have three cards left?!

lines.speaker: lolo_carding
lines.text: That can't be. You can't beat me in my own house!
